est_rules.$comment: ADR-004 method v1 / ADR-006 ranking. Change values here, not in code.
est_rules.$comment_peers: ADR-023: a claim that comes from a comparison table carries peers [{name, aa, aa_url, score}] measured in the same table; implied AA = peer AA + fit slope x (score - peer score), using peers within peer_max_gap points, weighted 1/(1 + gap/peer_scale). Vendor-only claims without usable peers get a vendor_only_band wide band and low confidence.
